no_adcom_quote.quote: The Agency conducted no advisory committee meeting regarding this application because there were no novel or complex regulatory issues related to efficacy or safety that required discussion with subject-matter experts.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for WINLEVI (clascoterone cream, 1%; NDA 213433). The Multidisciplinary Review and Evaluation states explicitly in Section 9 that the Agency held no advisory committee meeting because there were no novel or complex regulatory issues related to efficacy or safety requiring discussion with subject-matter experts. Accordingly there are no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
